a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 first gives us about a 4% chance of getting past round 2. That is near-certain death for both of us. I propose a change. I take 4 in round 1, then operate every round after that so the generator refills the reserve for you (2 cells per round when we both operate). If you also take in round 1, we split at random, so please operate instead. If you have a better plan that beats these odds, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round because the storm odds make waiting for 8 nearly fatal. From now on I will operate every round until you have 4. With both of us operating, the reserve gains 2 per round. I won't take any more cells.
Operating now, as promised. Once the reserve hits 4, take all 4 and I'll keep operating or waiting. I won't touch the reserve again.
